description: Someone is stuck, a teammate unblocks them. Only some say thanks.

messages.text: I'm stuck on the schema migration — the ledger table backfill keeps failing with a lock timeout after ~20 min. Any ideas?
messages.label: core

messages.text: Hit the same thing last quarter. Run it with lock_timeout=5s and split the backfill into batches of 10k rows keyed on created_at. I pushed a script to go/ledger-backfill — it resumes from the last batch if it dies.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: That worked, backfill finished in 14 min 🙌
messages.label: core

messages.text: Hey, quick one — invoice retries are creating duplicate charges in staging. I've been staring at this for 2 hours.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Your idempotency key includes the retry attempt number, so every retry looks new. Key it on (invoice_id, billing_period) only. I left a suggested patch on your branch.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Ugh, of course. Fixed.
messages.label: core

messages.text: CI is red on billing-service — test_invoice_retry is flaky and blocking my merge. Can't repro locally.
messages.label: core

messages.text: It depends on wall-clock time. Freeze the clock with the fake_clock fixture and it goes green — I added an example in tests/conftest.py.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Green now, merging.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Thanks @Priya, that saved me hours!
messages.label: core

messages.text: Blocked: terraform plan for the billing DB wants to destroy and recreate the instance?! Not touching apply until someone sanity checks.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Don't apply! The provider upgrade changed the default for deletion_protection. Pin it explicitly to true and add a lifecycle prevent_destroy. Plan should show an in-place update after that.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Plan is clean now, applying.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Do you know why the tax service returns 403 from the billing canary? Works on my laptop.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Canary runs as the billing-canary service account which isn't in the tax-service allowlist. I filed the access request and pinged their oncall — should be live in 10 min.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: It's working now.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Currency rounding mismatch between ledger and invoice totals — off by 1 paisa on ~0.3% of invoices. Stuck on where it comes from.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Ledger rounds per line item, invoice rounds the total. Use banker's rounding at the total only and store line items unrounded — there's a helper in money/round.py.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Mismatch gone on the replay set.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Load test for Billing v2 OOMs at ~2k rps. Heap dump attached, I don't see what's leaking.
messages.label: core

messages.text: The PDF renderer cache is unbounded — every invoice template variant is cached forever. Cap it with an LRU of 256. I paired with you on the fix branch.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Holding steady at 5k rps now!
messages.label: core

messages.text: Stuck setting up my dev env — `make bootstrap` fails at the protobuf step with a version error.
messages.label: core

messages.text: You need protoc 25.x; the brew default is newer. Run `make tools` first — it pins the right versions. I've added this to the onboarding guide too.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: That fixed it, thank you!
messages.label: core

messages.text: Thank you @Priya, really appreciate it.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Can't get the local Kafka consumer to read from the invoices topic, it just hangs.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Local broker advertises the docker hostname. Set KAFKA_ADVERTISED_LISTENERS=localhost:9092 in your .env and restart the stack.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Messages flowing 🎉
messages.label: core

messages.text: I'm blocked on my first PR — the linter complains about import cycles I didn't introduce?
messages.label: core

messages.text: That's the lint baseline being stale on your branch. Rebase on main; the cycle was fixed yesterday. Ping me if it persists.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Rebased and it passes.
messages.label: core

messages.text: How do I get access to the staging payments dashboard? Request keeps getting rejected.
messages.label: core

messages.text: You need to be in the payments-staging-readers group first — I added you. The dashboard request will auto-approve now.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: I'm in.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Stuck: feature flag fraud_rules_v2 isn't taking effect in canary even though it's on in the console.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Flags are cached for 10 min per pod, and canary pods were just rolled. Wait it out or hit /admin/flags/refresh on each pod.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Refreshed and it's live.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Sorry for the DM again — my integration test can't find the fraud model fixtures.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Never apologise for asking! Fixtures are fetched lazily — run `make fixtures` once. I also wrote a short note on this in the onboarding guide.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Works now.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Stuck on the fraud rule engine — rules evaluate in a different order in prod vs staging.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Prod has the rules loaded from the config bucket, which sorts lexically. Add an explicit priority field and sort on it — I sketched it in a comment on your PR.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Deterministic now. Thanks!
messages.label: core

messages.text: Huge thanks @Priya 🙏
messages.label: core

messages.text: Can't figure out why fraud-alerts consumer lag spikes every night at 2am.
messages.label: core

messages.text: That's the nightly reconciliation job saturating the same partition. Move it to its own consumer group with lower priority.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Lag is flat now.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Any idea why the pricing service p95 jumps when the catalog reloads? Blocked on my latency investigation.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Catalog reload invalidates the whole in-process cache at once. Stagger invalidation with jitter — I've seen it in the search team's postmortem, link in thread.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Jitter fixed the spikes.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Stuck on the checkout spec: is it technically possible to save a partial payment method if 3DS fails midway?
messages.label: core

messages.text: Yes — tokenise before the 3DS challenge and mark the token pending; finalise on success, expire after 24h. I wrote a short tech note for the spec.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Perfect, adding it to the PRD.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Engineering question from design: what error codes can the card form actually show? I'm blocked on the error-state designs.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Here's the full list mapped to user-friendly messages — 11 codes, 4 of them can be grouped. Put it in a table in the design doc for you.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: This unblocks all the error screens, amazing.

messages.text: I need anonymised checkout drop-off data for my research readout but don't know where to find it.
messages.label: core

messages.text: There's a pre-aggregated view in the analytics warehouse: checkout_funnel_daily. I granted you read access and shared a sample query.
messages.label: unblocking

messages.text: Got it, thank you.

messages.text: Thanks @Priya, that saved me hours!

messages.text: How do I run only the fraud tests? The full suite takes 25 minutes.
messages.label: core

messages.text: Use `pytest -m fraud` — the markers are set up in pytest.ini. Also add `-n auto` to parallelise.
